name: cavemio-floating-button-group
title: Floating button group
description: Floating canvas toolbar: one indicator thrown to the active tool, a zoom stepper whose value rolls, and a menu that grows out of its chevron.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The indicator is measured from layout offsets and re-measured on resize, so it stays under its tool at any width or zoom.
- Arrow keys, Home and End move between tools and select them; one tab stop for the tools.
- thin line only: no shadow, no blur behind the bar.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: One moving indicator
features.description: The active tool sits on one fill that is thrown to the next tool, measured from layout so it never drifts off its button.

features.title: Zoom stepper
features.description: Minus and plus with a percentage that rolls the way it changed, stopping at 25% and 300%.

features.title: FilterBar morphing menu
features.description: Trailing chevron opens an options panel that physically grows out of the trigger button.

features.title: Keyboard shortcuts
features.description: Displays hotkeys and handles full arrow-key and Escape accessibility.

states.title: idle
states.description: A thin line pill of 32px tools; the active one sits on a filled indicator.

states.title: select
states.description: The indicator is thrown to the new tool with a slight overshoot (420ms); hover only tints the tool under the pointer.

states.title: zoom
states.description: The percentage rolls in the direction it changed; the stepper ends disable at 25% and 300%.

states.title: menuOpen
states.description: The options panel grows out of the chevron (upward when docked at the bottom).
